entries.label: Old Snake — OctoCamo Digital Red
entries.episode: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (PS3 2008)
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create ONE production game sprite for CQC, Old Snake in the official MGS4 2008 Digital Red OctoCamo, accurately based on these three references. Image 1 is the canonical face and Solid Eye identity; image 2 shows segmented suit construction; image 3 is specifically the canonical Digital Red pixel camouflage palette and geometry, NOT the desired pose. Show a single full-body Old Snake in restrained fighting-ready stance facing screen right, 3/4 side profile suitable for a 2D fighting game. Both boots and all of his head visible, centered with ample margin. Grey slicked-back hair, grey moustache with NO beard, aged face, dark headband, Solid Eye on his anatomical LEFT eye. Detailed segmented OctoCamo suit with the muted dusty salmon/tan and dark brown/olive squared Digital Red pattern visible on the actual screenshot, NOT bright crimson, not solid red. Olive Command Vest, accurate utility pouches, belt and holster, gloves, knee pads and tactical boots. Sidearm held safely low, same character proportions. Hand-painted detailed HD 2D fighting sprite, crisp silhouette, realistic anatomy, restrained highlights, like premium modern painted fighting-game sprites. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no floor, no pedestal, no text, no logos, no UI, no additional views or frames. Preserve signature face, suit shape, gear, and canonical coloration from the references. Full body one asset one image, portrait 1024x1536.

notes: Un seul corps entier en posture droite ; visage âgé, moustache grise, gilet olive et camouflage à carrés saumon/brun vérifiés.
Palette vérifiée contre la capture originale Digital Red, pas un uniforme rouge vif.
Détails fins des panneaux, répartition exacte du motif et Solid Eye à examiner avant admission 1:1. La pose et le rendu 2D sont une adaptation CQC.
Alpha présent et mesuré ; aucune retouche ni réencodage des pixels.
